subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Seizure
solution: The correct answer is: **Capture** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • "**Seizure**" means taking hold of something by force or authority. (बलपूर्वक या अधिकार से किसी चीज़ पर कब्ज़ा करना) • **For example**: *The police made a seizure of illegal drugs during the raid.* • Marked option "**Capture**" means taking something or someone by force or skill. (किसी वस्तु या व्यक्ति को बलपूर्वक या कौशल से लेना) • **For example**: *They managed to capture the escaped prisoner.* • From here it is clear that the most appropriate synonym for 'Seizure' is 'Capture'. • "Capture" can also be used in a non-literal sense, such as capturing someone's attention or capturing a moment in a photograph. Therefore, the correct answer is **option 2**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • "**Governance**" refers to the act of governing or controlling a group of people or a country. (लोगों के किसी समूह या देश पर शासन या नियंत्रण करने का कार्य) • "**Stealing**" refers to taking something without permission or unlawfully. (बिना अनुमति या गैरकानूनी तरीके से कुछ लेना) • "**Demonstration**" refers to a public display or protest. (एक सार्वजनिक प्रदर्शन या विरोध) 4a:T68b, The correct answer is: "**A car is being bought by Daniel.**"
